newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Cable TV operator A2000 gets financing deal.
newsitem.headline: Cable TV operator A2000 gets financing deal.

text.p: Cable television operator A2000, a joint venture between Philips unit UPC and US West International, has been awarded a 45 million guilder financing arrangement, ABN AMRO Bank said on Wednesday.

The pact enables A2000 to expand and improve its cable network in the Dutch town of Hilversum, the bank said in a statement. The expanded network will offer additional facilities for multi-media purposes.
A2000 operates cable television networks in Amsterdam and Hilversum. Earlier this year the joint venture signed a 475 million guilder financing deal with ABN AMRO.
